text: Does the pain wake him up at night, and does he have any pain in his left hip or groin area when moving his leg? I would also like to examine his hip range of motion.

text: Many children with hip problems feel pain in the knee instead, so I need to check your hip movement. Please lie on your back and try to bring your left knee up toward your chest, and tell me if that movement hurts.
